title: Implementing Beige: Enterprise Treasury Onboarding
summary: This document covers Enterprise Treasury onboarding (“Implementing Beige”), including pre-onboarding responsibilities (executive sponsorship, authorized signers, documentation/policy/approval matrix), funding & balance setup (minimum $250,000; $200 monthly maintenance fee waived at $500,000 average), and go-live overdraft settings ($0.00). It also details dedicated support (2 account managers) and an operational readiness checklist (signer roles/entitlements, approval rules, statement delivery/reporting/reconciliation identifiers, and funding schedules).
faqs: What are the minimum balance and monthly maintenance fee requirements for the enterprise-level treasury account?
When is the $200.00 monthly maintenance fee waived, and how should we handle early balance variability to stay eligible?
What overdraft fee applies during go-live, and what should we do if we stagger incoming funds across multiple institutions?
Who is responsible for onboarding, and what preconditions (executive sponsorship, authorized signers) must be confirmed before starting?
How many dedicated account managers will we be assigned, and what do they coordinate during onboarding?
What items should be verified in the operational readiness checklist before the first close (entitlements, approvals, statement/reporting settings, reconciliation identifiers, funding schedules)?
